lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular maxima arranged in three quasi-parallel horizontal rows. The medial row exhibits consistent inter-blob spacing of approximately 1.5 to 2 blob diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, acting as grid nodes particularly visible in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper-medial flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient shift from superior highlight to inferior shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the anterior half of the fin surface.
